panels.finding: DA-MLDG leads in 2/7 scenarios; RSC leads in four.

panels.title: With pretrained speech embeddings
panels.subtitle: TRILLsson inputs · same seven scenarios · mean accuracy over ten trials
panels.finding: With pretrained embeddings, DA-MLDG beats the supervised baseline in 3/7 scenarios.

takeaways: Performance depends on the source–target split: DA-MLDG leads two of seven log-mel scenarios.
Pretrained features change the comparison: DA-MLDG beats supervised training in three of seven scenarios.

notes: All 42 displayed values were checked visually against Tables III and IV in the publisher PDF. Reported means average ten trials; no uncertainty is provided.

Table III winners: RSC in scenarios 1, 2, 6 and 7; Deep-All in 3; DA-MLDG in 4 and 5. Its scenario-4 advantage over Deep-All is only 0.05 percentage points and has no reported uncertainty, so no significance is asserted.
In Table IV, DA-MLDG exceeds Deep-All in scenarios 1, 5 and 6 only. Better inputs do not establish a consistent meta-learning advantage.
ShEMO is shown twice because scenarios 6 and 7 use different source corpora. Scenario identities are retained rather than pooled by target dataset.
No source values were corrected, averaged across scenarios, estimated from plots or promoted to deployment claims.
